verdict.rationale: Pika documents a 'Talking Head Video' app for making a virtual spokesperson (pika-docs-14) and a 'Podcast Video' app for turning topics into video episodes (pika-docs-20). It also offers voiceover generation, including Eleven Multilingual v2 (pika-docs-10, pika-docs-16). Together these suggest characters can speak supplied dialogue, but no evidence explicitly says mouth movement is synced to the audio. Missing for 10: explicit lip-sync documentation, support for driving custom generated characters with user-supplied audio, details on lip-sync quality, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
